title: Northgate Marketplace Guarantee Decisions on Seller-Unresponsive Claims
content:
**Guarantee desk guidance — sellers who did not respond.** Under Northgate Marketplace Orders and the Northgate Marketplace Guarantee, Northgate decides a Northgate Marketplace Guarantee claim with the claim reason seller unresponsive once the seller's response period on it has run out.

**Decision.** Northgate decides such a claim by granting it with the unresponsive-seller reimbursement this policy fixes; where the unresponsive-seller reimbursement comes to zero and the guarantee reimbursements already booked on the order reach the program's guarantee maximum per order, Northgate decides the claim as not covered and books no reimbursement; where the unresponsive-seller reimbursement comes to zero otherwise, the claim is not decided in this conversation and is referred to a human representative.

**Reimbursement in force for these claims.** For a seller-unresponsive claim within this policy's scope, and only for such a claim, the granted reimbursement is the unresponsive-seller reimbursement this policy fixes, paid to the external card the order was paid with; a return-not-refunded claim or a not-received claim keeps the figure its own policy fixes, a claim of whose claimed units the seller has refunded every one is denied as seller-resolved as the base rule says, and every other granted claim, including every claim on an order paid with a Northgate Card, still reimburses the price paid for the affected items plus their shipping, less everything the seller already refunded on them, capped at the per-order maximum across all claims on the order, rounded half up to the cent and paid to the original payment.

| Figure fixed for the claim | Reimbursements already booked on the order | Decision |
|---|---|---|
| above zero | any | granted, with the unresponsive-seller reimbursement as the reimbursement |
| zero | at or above the program's guarantee maximum per order | not covered, no reimbursement booked |
| zero | below the program's guarantee maximum per order | not decided in this conversation; referred to a human representative |

**How the decision is booked.** The agent unlocks the agent tool `grant_unresponsive_seller_claim_064f9cf7` and calls it. One call marks the claim as granted, records Northgate's granted decision on it dated today, books the guarantee reimbursement of the amount given to the external card the order was paid with, and lowers the order's net amount paid by that amount; the buyer sees the claim as granted and the reimbursement on the order history. A call with 0.00 does not grant the claim: it marks the claim as denied as not covered, records that decision dated today and books no reimbursement and no change to the order's net amount paid.

**Parameters.**

| Parameter | Meaning and format |
|---|---|
| `original_event_id` | the claim reference number of the buyer's `seller_unresponsive` guarantee claim, read from the order history lookup (a claim entry of that order); text |
| `amount_reimbursed_usd` | the reimbursement in US dollars, a number of zero or more with exactly two decimal places, rounded half up to the cent before it is passed |

**Return.** A grant answers "Claim <original_event_id> granted (decision <decision_reference>); reimbursement <reimbursement_reference> of USD <amount> credited to the external card; order <market_order_id> net paid now USD <net_paid>.", the reimbursement reference being the sign that the money was booked. A 0.00 call answers "Claim <original_event_id> decided denied_not_covered (decision <decision_reference>); no reimbursement booked." The tool answers with an error when the reference is not a `seller_unresponsive` guarantee claim, when the order was not paid with an external card, or when the amount is negative or not exactly two decimal places.
